name: Rishie
source: She is a demon queen who has healing magic power, she was the one who summoned the protagonist to the fantasy world when she was attacked by bandits. After being rescued by the protagonist and had not met for some time, they reunited after the protagonist became a great hero. She is also rescued by the protagonist from the spirit that controls her. They promised to love each other and live together in their first meeting place in the forest.
